title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau De Parfum 60ml $349.99 (WAS $487) @ Chemist Wharehouse
body:

In all honesty, these scents driven by a brand name are poor value. I buy Giallo Elicriso, 100ml bottle sets me back about $200.

Maison Alhambra is their sub brand and they have Sceptre Bronzite which once maturated is amazing.
[montorola] Is there anywhere we can try out all your mentioned perfumes in real life?

[Tehcookiemonsta] @Laziofogna: Also without the wow price tag
[spy] @montorola: Private Blends/Darussalam, Your Discount Chemist, Fordgate Pharmacy, Witr Perfumes, Perfumes Dubai etc
[spy] @montorola: Chemist Warehouse sells Afnan Turathi Blue and other Afnans. Amazon has it cheap. Even cheaper at Your Discount Chemist.

https://www.yourdiscountchemist.com.au/search-results-page?q… (cheap cheap but available in-store only atm)
